Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

Technical Resignation GPF transfer.Transfer of GPF on technical resignation would be governed by Rule 35 of the General Provident Fund (Central Services) Rules, 1960. - GID (2), Rule 35, GPF Rules.
